title: A Comparability Protocol for Benchmarking Relational Database Access Layers in Express.js
description: Version 1.12.15 is the complete July 26 IST revision artifact. It adds an expected-result oracle derived from the deterministic seed specification, exact campaign-state and seed-parity gates, a corrected 90-cell primary campaign, a separate 42-cell same-host RQ2 validation campaign, fresh common-SQL/capacity/matched-utilization/long-tail analyses, exact measurement-source snapshots, a 63-judgement external-protocol audit, and blind human-review packets. The accepted campaigns contain 2,250 and 1,050 complete run-level observations with zero timed request failures. Sixty archived JSON inputs verify and the current-candidate author reconstruction regenerates 35 table outputs plus four derived analysis JSON files byte-for-byte. Independent human adapter review, independent third-party reproduction, and cross-host replication are not claimed. This maintenance release also synchronizes both tracked supplement PDFs with the final 42-page supplement source.
